mapper.select: SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm , tb.expp_scre , tb.expp_rnk , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_dir_symb_nm , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tb.expp_dir_symb_nm ORDER BY tb.expp_rnk) AS dir_rank FROM tmm_bztgtprdcexppinfom tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} AND tb.expp_dir_symb_nm = #{direction} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY tb.expp_rnk LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_nm , tb.expp_dtl_cntt , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm FROM tmm_bztgtexppcnttd tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = expp_lvl_dtl_nm AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_nm , tb.expp_dtl_cntt , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm FROM tmm_bztgtexppcnttd tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' AND tb.expp_lvl_nm != expp_lvl_dtl_nm AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} AND tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd = #{predictionInputMnemonicCd} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.mrkt_idx_data_no , a.ric_cd , a.mnmnc_cd , b.instm_cltn_tbl_nm , b.instm_data_spt_cd , a.gds_data_src_no FROM tmm_mrktidxdatam a , tmm_mrktidxdatad b WHERE a.mrkt_idx_data_no = b.mrkt_idx_data_no AND a.del_yn = b.del_yn AND a.del_yn = 'N' AND b.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd = #{marketIndexAnalysisTargetCd} AND (a.ric_cd = #{mnemonicCd} OR a.mnmnc_cd = #{mnemonicCd}); LIMIT 1
